source: S&P 500 constituents from Wikipedia; company financial statements, market cap and prices from Yahoo Finance via yfinance
universe_method: Current S&P 500 constituents backcast to their available annual financial history
history_window: latest up to 5 available fiscal years
notes: Sector ratios are aggregated from numerator/denominator totals, not simple averages of company ratios.
Historical market cap uses fiscal-date close multiplied by reported shares outstanding when available; current shares are a fallback.

Financials excludes corporate-style net debt/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC and EBITDA margin as non-comparable. P/TBV and ROTCE use a tangible common equity proxy defined as book equity less goodwill and identifiable intangibles.

P/NAV, NIM, NPL ratio and CET1 ratio require specialized REIT/bank disclosures and are intentionally left blank until a dedicated comparable source is integrated; generic accounting proxies are not substituted.
Dividend Yield is a trailing cash-dividend yield based on reported cash dividends paid divided by market capitalization; it is not a forward indicated yield.
Real Estate FFO is a proxy defined as net income plus depreciation and amortization; it does not adjust for property-sale gains/losses and is therefore not official NAREIT FFO/AFFO.
